column2: Verify Evalustion present in the RFX can be evalaluated.
column4: convert a Released intake to an RFX carrying an Evaluation / quote the RFX answering the evaluated section, then foreclose / score the evaluation and see it recorded
column5:
1. Find a Released intake on /intakes and open it.
2. Process -> Send For Sourcing; fill Payment Terms, both bid due dates and the expected delivery date; add the supplier.
3. Submit and approve the sourcing event until it is Released.
4. Add an Evaluation: label, Section 'RFP T&C - Letter of Commitment', Rating Type Rating, Approval Type Any Approver, Evaluator NSEF Support Admin.
5. Assert it appears on the Evaluations tab.
6. Submit Quote -> Commercial Quote; set currency and unit rate; ANSWER every question in the evaluated section; submit.
7. Foreclose the RFX.
8. Evaluations tab -> expand -> Evaluate -> for EACH answer hover it, click the 5th star, type a reason, click that answer's tick -> then the tick on the evaluation's header line.
9. Assert every answer is scored and green, the status is Completed, and the Activity Log records 'Evaluation has been submitted'.
column6: An evaluation present in the RFX can be evaluated.
column7:
PASS end to end (live 2026-09-02, 4.1 min): built RFX-26-242 from INT-FNSE-26-374, created the evaluation, answered 4 questions, quoted, foreclosed, rated all 3 answers 5/5 with reasons -> submit returned 200 -> status Completed, 3/3 answers green, Activity Log shows 'Evaluation has been submitted by NSEF Support Admin'.
DEFECT-SHAPED BEHAVIOUR WORTH KNOWING: per-answer ticks save NOTHING to the server - ratings are held in the browser and the header tick posts them all at once. If one star click is swallowed the header tick still submits the rest, and the evaluation lands on 'Partially Completed' with that answer left uncoloured and no warning. Reproduced on RFX-26-235 (answer 1 lost, answers 2-3 saved). The test now confirms each star click by waiting for the comment popover, then RELOADS after submitting and re-rates anything the server did not keep.
Detection traps: a scored answer still shows its answer text ('Yes'), and hovering an UNSCORED row renders all five stars filled - so neither text nor star fill can tell scored from unscored. The only honest marker is the lucide-user-round-check icon (and the green cell) the app adds to a scored answer.
NOTE: QA described adding the Evaluation on the CONVERSION page - that control exists ('Add evaluation', lower-case e) but is an INLINE click-to-edit grid; the RFX page offers the same thing as a clean Create Evaluation dialog and is used instead, still before the RFX is quoted.
